title: Fred Morris, finding the net.
deck: The goals at the heart of a title-winning season.
body: Fred Morris scored 37 league goals in Albion’s championship season of 1919/20. He became the first Albion player to pass 30 in a league campaign and finished as the First Division’s leading scorer.

Five of his goals came in an 8–0 victory over Notts County. His record belongs within a team story rather than apart from it: the championship combined prolific scoring with an experienced defence. Open the team photograph to see the men behind the figures.
